other_failure_modes.description: Performing frequency encoding or groupby statistical aggregations on the concatenated train and test datasets leaks test set distribution statistics into the training features.

summary: The agent implements a generally solid pipeline with K-Fold cross-validation, OOF target encoding, and an ensemble of LightGBM and CatBoost. However, it introduces data leakage by fitting transformers (TF-IDF, TruncatedSVD) and calculating distribution statistics (frequency encoding, groupby aggregations) on the combined train and test datasets before splitting. Additionally, the ensembling is naive (equal weights) and only a single metric is evaluated.
